title: conductoR analytical plan, language version 0.3
description: An analytical plan: a directed acyclic graph of nodes, each bound to a tool or to an operator the engine performs. Every field added in versions 0.2 and 0.3 is optional, so a version 0.1 or 0.2 plan is a valid version 0.3 plan. plan_validate() in R makes the same checks and adds those this schema cannot express: every edge and every condition names a node of the plan, the graph has no cycle, conditions and postconditions follow the grammar, and trigger, hypothesis and postcondition ids are unique.

plan_version.description: The version of the plan language, as a quoted string. Absent means "0.1".

meta.description: Free-form information about the plan, such as the question it answers.

inputs.description: The tables the plan reads and the postconditions each must meet before the first node runs.

nodes.description: The steps of the plan. Order does not matter; the engine orders them by their edges.

text.description: A string. A number in scientific notation written as text is refused; write numbers plainly.

target.description: An inferential target of the orchestraManifest contract, or "any".

condition.description: A condition in the plan grammar: references such as lens.headline, lens.abstained, lens.n_rows or lens.metrics.p_value (in a select rule, column names), numbers written plainly, quoted strings, TRUE, FALSE, the comparisons == != < <= > >=, %in% with c(...), & | ! and brackets. Function calls, $, ::, backticks and assignment are refused.

edge.description: An input of the node: the upstream node and the inferential target it must declare.

id.description: The node's name, unique within the plan. No dots, square brackets or white space.

role.description: A free-text label for the component.

tool.description: A registered tool name, a pkg::fn reference or script:<path>::<fn>.

operator.description: compute calls the tool; abstain_gate, triangulate and select are performed by the engine.

emits.description: The inferential target the node's result must declare.

params.description: Parameters passed to the tool or the operator.

when.description: Run the node only when this condition is TRUE; otherwise it and its descendants are skipped.

foreach.description: Run the node once per item: a list of items, or the distinct values of a column of the params table of a node it consumes.

foreach_max.description: The largest number of items allowed; default 50.

on_refusal.description: What an abstaining result does: continue (default), halt-branch (skip descendants) or stop (end the run).

returns.description: The values the node may return at a dose.

postcondition.description: A condition the input table must meet: bare column names are checked row by row; .n_rows, .n_cols, .n_missing.<column>, .n_distinct.<column>, .n_duplicated.<column>, .min.<column>, .max.<column> and .levels.<column> summarise the table.

input.description: A table the plan reads, named as in the data passed to conduct().

key.description: Columns whose combined values are unique and never missing.

return_request.description: A value the node may return, and the dose it needs. A params field may carry a row filter, params.<column>[<key>=<value>,...].

digits.description: Significant figures of the returned numbers.

trigger.description: A signal declared before the run on one statistic of the node.

hypothesis.description: A hypothesis tested on one statistic of the node, with what rehearsal planted to show the rule fires and stays silent.
